description: This file defines the Newsletter controller class for the 'account' section of the OpenCart catalog. It handles displaying the newsletter subscription page and saving newsletter preferences for logged-in customers.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: Controller class for customer newsletter subscription management within the account section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the newsletter subscription page, ensuring the customer is logged in and setting up breadcrumbs and page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of newsletter subscription preferences, including customer authentication, updating the database, and returning a JSON response.
